leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a deep copy of a linked list with random pointers using a two-pass approach
Initialize a hash map to store original-to-copy node relationships
Manipulate pointer connections to replicate both next and random references
Apply iterative traversal to create new nodes and populate the mapping
Integrate the mapping step with the pointer wiring step in a complete solution
Control memory allocation by reusing existing nodes through the mapping structure
Implement validation checks to handle edge cases like empty lists or null pointers
